task.goal: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a calendar event on 2023-10-20 at 18h with the title 'Call with Alice' and the description 'We will prepare for upcoming project milestones.'. The event should last for 30 mins.
task.final_summary: Created the event "Call with Alice" in Simple Calendar Pro on Friday, October 20, 2023, from 18:00 to 18:30 (30 minutes), with the description "We will prepare for upcoming project milestones." I verified it by searching the title in the app, which returned the single event with the correct date, time and description, then cleared the search.

steps.note: Load Simple Calendar skill, then observe screen
Observe current screen
Launch Simple Calendar Pro and observe
Open new event form via FAB
Tap Event label to open event form
Type title, then description
Type description, then set start date
Open start date picker
Read date picker dialog
Select 20 Oct 2023 in date picker and tap OK
Confirm date; then set end date to Oct 20
Open start time picker and set 18:00
Switch to text input mode in time picker
Type hour 18, verify hour and minute, then OK
Read time picker text fields state after typing
Confirm start time 18:00, then set end time
Open end time picker and set 18:30
Switch to text input mode for end time
Tap minute field and type 30
Type minute 30 and read fields
Read minute field value
Restore hour to 18
Read hour/minute fields after typing 18
Type minute 30 and verify
Confirm end time 18:30 and read the event form
Tap Save and verify the event appears
Dismiss disclaimer and verify event saved
Search for the saved event to verify
Clear search and re-read final screen; then done
Task complete
